posts.author: ghostyface_sls
posts.body:
Hello! I am making a Church right now for my game, and I can't seem to find any good church bells or exterior tiles anywhere. I have a tight budget and I'd like to keep things as close to the RTP-Style as possible, which honestly limits my choices... But it's better this way as I'm still learning my way through the engine.
Basically: I'm looking for a church tileset. My main concern as of now is a church bell, but any recommendations for a good church exterior tileset would be helpful as well.
I have already downloaded a few RTP-Friendly and awesome tilesets for churches, but they don't include what I'm looking for.
Thank you for your time!

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Maru has a swinging bell that you can edit into a church, but you must own Ace for it:
RPG Maker VX Ace – Characters
Nutzungsbestimmungen Diese Ressourcen sind für den RPG Maker VX Ace von Enterbrain erstellt, nur mit der Lizenz für diesen Maker und nur in RM-Projekten zu verwenden. Sie nutzten das RTP als Basis…
